controls.label: Freeze...
controls.tooltip: Freeze...{binding} · turn the curves and subdivision-surface polygons into plain geometry (the selected ones in Polygon mode) · poly.freeze

controls.label: Boolean...
controls.tooltip: Boolean...{binding} · Union, Intersect, Subtract or Add the active mesh with driver meshes (visible unselected meshes by default) · poly.boolean

controls.label: Solid Drill...
controls.tooltip: Solid Drill...{binding} · Cut the active mesh's polygons where a closed driver passes through them: keep the inside (Core) or outside (Tunnel), or keep both (Stencil, Slice) · poly.solidDrill

controls.label: Axis Drill...
controls.tooltip: Axis Drill...{binding} · Cut the active mesh's polygons with the driver's outline pushed straight along X, Y or Z · poly.drill

controls.label: Curve Boolean...
controls.tooltip: Curve Boolean... · slice, unite, intersect or subtract the selected closed curves with the other curves · curve.boolean

controls.label: Topology Pen
controls.tooltip: Topology Pen{binding} · Drag an element to move it; Shift+drag an edge to pull out a new strip onto the background mesh · tool.set mesh.topology on

controls.label: Retopo Sketch
controls.tooltip: Retopo Sketch{binding} · Drag across a background mesh to draw a guide curve on it

controls.label: Automatic Retopology...
controls.tooltip: Automatic Retopology...{binding} · Rebuild the whole active mesh as even quads that follow its shape · mesh.retopo

controls.label: Remesh...
controls.tooltip: Remesh...{binding} · Rebuild the whole active mesh: Voxel (sculpt.remesh), or Blocks, Smooth and Sharp on an octree (operandi.remesh)

controls.label: Fix Black Dots
controls.tooltip: Fix Black Dots · merge polygon pairs that share a run of edges (pinches that shade as dark dots), on the whole active mesh · operandi.mesh.fixBlackDots

controls.label: Edge Zip
controls.tooltip: Edge Zip · needs a selection: edges with a quad on each side; welds the rows either side onto them · operandi.edge.zip

controls.label: Diagonal Re-Direct
controls.tooltip: Diagonal Re-Direct · needs a selection: two quads touching at one corner; turns the edge flow 45° · operandi.poly.diagonalRedirect

controls.label: Retopo Edge Lock
controls.tooltip: Retopo Edge Lock{binding} · Add the selected guide curves to the RetopoEdgeLock selection set

controls.label: Retopo Edge Flow
controls.tooltip: Retopo Edge Flow{binding} · Add the selected guide curves to the RetopoEdgeFlow selection set
